name: Buffalo with sour bamboo
nameVi: Thịt trâu gác bếp xào măng chua
summary: Smoked buffalo stir-fried with sour bamboo, a Tay dish of the lake. It is not the dried-buffalo gift, and not the pork over the fire.
origin: Tay cooking of the lake, as listed by Vietnam Tourism's ethnic desk on 3 November 2024.
howToEat: The ethnic desk names smoked buffalo stir-fried with sour bamboo.
Dried buffalo, thịt trâu khô, is a separate gift on the district OCOP list.
where: Shown as lake Tay food at the 2024 Northeast festival in Lang Son.
seoTitle: Buffalo with sour bamboo at Ba Be
seoDescription: Smoked buffalo stir-fried with sour bamboo, a Tay dish of the lake. It is not the dried-buffalo gift, and not the pork over the fire.
